A collection of links I find useful when advising students.

## Majors and Programs

- Computer Science: [BCS](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/bachelor-computer-science-bcs), [CS Plus](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/computer-science-plus), and [CS Minor](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/computer-science-plus) (same page as CS Plus)
- [Data Science](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/data-science-major-bs-minor) major and minor

Consider adding one of the following to your program:

- [Cybersecurity Certificate](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/cybersecurity-certificate)
- For CS students, adding a [Data Science](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/data-science-major-bs-minor) minor or a [Statistics minor](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/statistics-major-ba-minor) may only require one or two additional courses.
- For Data Science students, consider a Computer Science minor.
- Consider the [Information Systems minor](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/information-systems-minor) or the [Entrepreneurship minor](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/entrepreneurship-major-ba-minor)
- If you're adding a minor or second major, you might also consider the [Collegiate Scholars](https://calvin.edu/majors-programs/collegiate-scholars) program.

## Spring 2027 Courses

Each course is listed once with all of its open sections. For courses with a lab, register for one lecture section and one lab section; the section letters don't need to match. Courses marked *1st half* or *2nd half* meet for only half the semester. Click "Description" to see the catalog description. The calendar shows when everything meets; click a block to jump to that course.

```{python}
#| output: false

import json
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from html import escape

with open("backend/data/CourseSchedule-27SP.json") as f:
    report = json.load(f)["report"]

# Only regular Spring-term sections that are still open (skips Winter Intensive).
report = [
    r for r in report
    if r["Status"] != "Closed" and r["AcadPeriod"].startswith("2027 Spring")
]


def meeting(r):
    parts = []
    for seg in r["MtgPattern"].split(";"):
        fields = [f.strip() for f in seg.split("|")]
        if fields[0]:
            parts.append(" ".join(fields[:2]))
    return ", ".join(parts) or "TBA"


def half(r):
    """'1st half' / '2nd half' for 7-week courses, else None."""
    start, end = r["StartDt"][5:], r["EndDt"][5:]
    if start >= "03-01":
        return "2nd half"
    if end <= "03-31":
        return "1st half"
    return None


def course_num(r):
    # "108L" -> ("108", True)
    m = re.match(r"(\d+)(L?)", r["Crs_Number"])
    return m.group(1), bool(m.group(2))


def sortkey(num):
    return int(re.match(r"\d+", num).group())


# Cross-listings: same title, time, and instructor under different subjects.
xlist = defaultdict(set)
for r in report:
    xlist[(r["Section_Title"], r["MtgPattern"], r["Instructors"])].add(
        f"{r['Subject_RefID']} {r['Crs_Number']}"
    )


def cross_listed(r):
    me = f"{r['Subject_RefID']} {r['Crs_Number']}"
    return sorted(xlist[(r["Section_Title"], r["MtgPattern"], r["Instructors"])] - {me})


def section_item(r):
    h = half(r)
    tag = ""
    if h:
        dates = f"{r['StartDt'][5:].replace('-', '/')}–{r['EndDt'][5:].replace('-', '/')}"
        tag = f' <span class="tag{" h2" if h.startswith("2") else ""}" title="{dates}">{h}</span>'
    return (
        f"<li><b>{escape(r['Sec_Number'])}</b> · {escape(meeting(r))} · "
        f"{escape(r['Instructors'])}{tag}</li>"
    )


def hours(lectures, labs):
    hrs = sorted({r["Hours"] for r in lectures})
    s = "/".join(hrs) + (" hr" if hrs == ["1"] else " hrs")
    if labs:
        s += f" + {labs[0]['Hours']} hr lab"
    return s


def show(subj):
    courses = defaultdict(lambda: {"lec": [], "lab": []})
    for r in report:
        if r["Subject_RefID"] != subj:
            continue
        num, is_lab = course_num(r)
        courses[num]["lab" if is_lab else "lec"].append(r)

    print('<table class="table table-sm courses"><tbody>')
    for num in sorted(courses, key=sortkey):
        lec = sorted(courses[num]["lec"], key=lambda r: r["Sec_Number"])
        lab = sorted(courses[num]["lab"], key=lambda r: r["Sec_Number"])
        first = (lec or lab)[0]

        # Special-topics courses put the real description in Notes.
        desc = escape(next((r["Desc"].strip() for r in lec + lab if r["Desc"]), ""))
        notes = (first["Notes"] or "")
        if "Special Topic" in notes:
            desc = re.sub(r"\s*Fee: \$\d+", "", notes) + (f"<p>{desc}</p>" if desc else "")

        print(f"<tr id='crs-{subj}-{num}'><td class='crs'>")
        print(f"<span class='num'>{subj} {num}</span> {escape(first['Section_Title'])}")
        print(f"<div class='meta'>{hours(lec, lab)}</div>")
        xl = cross_listed(first)
        if xl:
            print(f"<div class='xlist'>Cross-listed as {' and '.join(xl)}</div>")
        if desc:
            print(f"<details><summary>Description</summary>{desc}</details>")
        print("</td><td>")
        if lab:
            print("<div class='kind'>Lecture: pick one</div>" if len(lec) > 1 else "<div class='kind'>Lecture</div>")
        print("<ul>" + "".join(section_item(r) for r in lec) + "</ul>")
        if lab:
            print("<div class='kind'>Lab: pick any one</div>" if len(lab) > 1 else "<div class='kind'>Lab</div>")
            print("<ul>" + "".join(section_item(r) for r in lab) + "</ul>")
        print("</td></tr>")
    print("</tbody></table>\n")


SUBJECTS = ["CS", "DATA", "STAT", "MATH"]
DAYS = {"M": 0, "T": 1, "W": 2, "TH": 3, "F": 4}


def minutes(t):
    m = re.match(r"(\d+):(\d+) (AM|PM)", t.strip())
    h, mi, ampm = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)
    return (h % 12 + (12 if ampm == "PM" else 0)) * 60 + mi


def halves(dates):
    # "01/19/2027 - 03/05/2027" -> which half-semesters this meeting is in
    start, end = [d.strip()[:5] for d in dates.split("-")]
    if start >= "03/01":
        return [2]
    if end <= "03/31":
        return [1]
    return [1, 2]


def calendar_events():
    events, seen = [], set()
    for r in report:
        subj = r["Subject_RefID"]
        key = (r["Section_Title"], r["MtgPattern"], r["Instructors"])
        if subj not in SUBJECTS or key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)  # cross-listed sections are drawn once
        num, is_lab = course_num(r)
        for seg in r["MtgPattern"].split(";"):
            fields = [f.strip() for f in seg.split("|")]
            if len(fields) < 3 or not fields[0]:
                continue
            days = [DAYS[d] for d in re.findall(r"TH|M|T|W|F", fields[0])]
            start, end = [minutes(t) for t in fields[1].split("-")]
            events.append({
                "course": f"{subj} {num}",
                "label": f"{subj} {r['Crs_Number']}-{r['Sec_Number']}",
                "short": f"{r['Crs_Number']}-{r['Sec_Number']}",
                "title": r["Section_Title"],
                "info": f"{fields[0]} {fields[1]} · {r['Instructors']}",
                "xlist": cross_listed(r),
                "subjects": sorted({c.split()[0] for c in xlist[key]}),
                "days": days, "start": start, "end": end,
                "halves": halves(fields[2]),
                "lab": is_lab,
                "href": f"#crs-{subj}-{num}",
            })
    return events
```

### Weekly Calendar

```{python}
#| output: asis
data = json.dumps(calendar_events()).replace("</", "<\\/")
print(f"<script>window.CAL_EVENTS = {data};</script>")
```

```{=html}
<style>
.cal-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5em 1.5em; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.75em; font-size: 0.9em; }
.cal-controls label { cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.cal-controls input[type="checkbox"] { accent-color: var(--cal-color, #2563eb); margin: 0 0.25em 0 0.15em; vertical-align: -0.05em; }
.cal-controls .half-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25em; }
.cal-controls .half-label { font-weight: 600; margin-right: 0.25em; }
.cal-controls .half-opt { border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.15em 0.6em; background: #fff; }
.cal-controls .half-opt input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.cal-controls .half-opt:has(input:checked) { background: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb; color: #fff; }
.cal-controls .legend { color: #6c757d; }
.cal-controls .legend .lab { display: inline-block; width: 1.4em; height: 0.8em; border: 1px dashed #6c757d; background: #e9ecef; vertical-align: -0.05em; }
.cal-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
.cal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.2em repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); min-width: 640px; font-size: 0.72rem; }
.cal .dayhead { text-align: center; font-weight: 600; padding-bottom: 0.2em; border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
.cal .hours, .cal .day { position: relative; }
.cal .day { border-left: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
.cal .hour { position: absolute; right: 0.4em; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #6c757d; }
.cal .ev { position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 1px 3px; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; line-height: 1.15;
  color: #fff; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid #fff; transition: opacity 0.1s; }
.cal .ev.lab { color: #212529; border-style: dashed; }
.cal .ev:hover { z-index: 2; }
.cal.hl .ev { opacity: 0.2; }
.cal.hl .ev.on { opacity: 1; }
</style>
<div class="cal-controls" id="cal-controls"></div>
<div class="cal-scroll"><div class="cal" id="cal"></div></div>
<script>
(() => {
  const COLORS = { CS: "#2563eb", DATA: "#059669", STAT: "#d97706", MATH: "#7c3aed" };
  const HOUR_PX = 46;
  const events = window.CAL_EVENTS;
  const lo = Math.floor(Math.min(...events.map(e => e.start)) / 60) * 60;
  const hi = Math.ceil(Math.max(...events.map(e => e.end)) / 60) * 60;
  const px = m => (m - lo) / 60 * HOUR_PX;
  const fmt = m => `${(Math.floor(m / 60) + 11) % 12 + 1}${m >= 720 ? "pm" : "am"}`;
  const state = { half: 1, subjects: new Set(Object.keys(COLORS)) };

  const controls = document.getElementById("cal-controls");
  const halfOpts = [[1, "1st half (Jan 19 – Mar 5)"], [2, "2nd half (Mar 15 – May 6)"]]
    .map(([v, t]) => `<label class="half-opt"><input type="radio" name="cal-half" value="${v}" ${v === 1 ? "checked" : ""}><span>${t}</span></label>`).join("");
  controls.innerHTML =
    `<span class="half-group"><span class="half-label">Half:</span>${halfOpts}</span>` +
    `<span>${Object.entries(COLORS).map(([s, c]) =>
      `<label><input type="checkbox" value="${s}" checked style="--cal-color:${c}">${s}</label>`).join(" ")}</span>` +
    `<span class="legend"><span class="lab"></span> lab</span>`;
  controls.addEventListener("change", e => {
    if (e.target.name === "cal-half") state.half = +e.target.value;
    else if (e.target.checked) state.subjects.add(e.target.value);
    else state.subjects.delete(e.target.value);
    render();
  });

  // Side-by-side layout for overlapping blocks: group transitively-overlapping
  // events into clusters, then give each event the first free column.
  function layout(evs) {
    evs.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || b.end - a.end);
    let cluster = [], clusterEnd = -1;
    const flush = () => {
      const cols = [];
      for (const e of cluster) {
        let c = cols.findIndex(end => end <= e.start);
        if (c < 0) { c = cols.length; cols.push(0); }
        cols[c] = e.end; e.col = c;
      }
      // Let each event widen into free columns to its right.
      for (const e of cluster) {
        e.ncols = cols.length;
        e.span = 1;
        while (e.col + e.span < e.ncols && !cluster.some(o =>
          o.col === e.col + e.span && o.start < e.end && e.start < o.end)) e.span++;
      }
    };
    for (const e of evs) {
      if (e.start >= clusterEnd && cluster.length) { flush(); cluster = []; }
      cluster.push(e); clusterEnd = Math.max(clusterEnd, e.end);
    }
    if (cluster.length) flush();
    return evs;
  }

  const cal = document.getElementById("cal");
  function render() {
    const height = px(hi);
    let html = `<div></div>` + ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"].map(d => `<div class="dayhead">${d}</div>`).join("");
    html += `<div class="hours" style="height:${height}px">`;
    for (let m = lo; m <= hi; m += 60) html += `<div class="hour" style="top:${px(m)}px">${fmt(m)}</div>`;
    html += `</div>`;
    const grid = `repeating-linear-gradient(#dee2e6 0 1px, transparent 1px ${HOUR_PX}px)`;
    const visible = events.filter(e => e.halves.includes(state.half) && e.subjects.some(s => state.subjects.has(s)));
    for (let d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
      html += `<div class="day" style="height:${height}px; background:${grid}">`;
      for (const e of layout(visible.filter(e => e.days.includes(d)).map(e => ({ ...e })))) {
        const color = COLORS[e.course.split(" ")[0]];
        const bg = e.lab ? `background:${color}33; border-color:${color}` : `background:${color}`;
        const tip = `${e.label} ${e.title}\n${e.info}` + (e.xlist.length ? `\nCross-listed as ${e.xlist.join(", ")}` : "");
        html += `<a class="ev${e.lab ? " lab" : ""}" href="${e.href}" data-course="${e.course}" title="${tip.replace(/"/g, "&quot;")}"
          style="top:${px(e.start)}px; height:${px(e.end) - px(e.start)}px; left:${e.col / e.ncols * 100}%; width:${e.span / e.ncols * 100}%; ${bg}">${e.short}</a>`;
      }
      html += `</div>`;
    }
    cal.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Hovering a block highlights every lecture and lab section of that course.
  cal.addEventListener("mouseover", e => {
    const ev = e.target.closest(".ev");
    cal.classList.toggle("hl", !!ev);
    for (const b of cal.querySelectorAll(".ev")) b.classList.toggle("on", !!ev && b.dataset.course === ev.dataset.course);
  });
  cal.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => cal.classList.remove("hl"));

  render();
})();
</script>
```
